item.title: What sorcery is this? Telstra actually has some excellent NBN deals
item.description: Telstra, Australia's biggest internet service provider by market share, has dropped some super-rare NBN deals, with savings of up to AU$240 for a limited time.

item.title: 71,207 drones broke world record in Texas using Chinese expertise and intriguing 'drone-in-a-box' concept — Shenzhen-based Damoda teamed with Sky Elements to bring 10000-strong dragon to life
item.description: Sky Elements and Damoda used 71,207 drones in Texas to break two Guinness records, including one for a giant aerial dragon.

item.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
item.description: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

item.title: AI agents need limits on financial access
item.description: AI agents are gaining access to bank accounts, raising serious concerns about security and whether the technology industry's obsession with automation is putting people's money at unnecessary risk.

item.title: iPhone Lockdown Mode: The pros and cons of enabling Apple's security feature
item.description: Lockdown Mode enables extreme protections for those most at risk, but it's overkill for most people.

item.title: World's largest cargo drone packs a 50-foot wingspan and 4,000lb payload — but you'll never find a human pilot inside
item.description: Poseidon Aerospace is developing Egret, a 50-foot autonomous cargo drone that carries 4,000 pounds but has no cockpit.
